harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, node3 (initial standbys) on RHEL10. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, then rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup as a standby of node2. Verified data consistency at each stage. Completed mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node3, then node2 (final primary) one at a time, each confirmed via changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, with PostgreSQL service and replication/recovery state verified healthy after each restart, and a final end-to-end write (row 6) confirmed replicated to both standbys.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server 16.14 on node1, node2, node3
Initialized primary DB on node1, configured wal_level/max_wal_senders/pg_hba for replication, opened firewalld postgresql service on all nodes
Created replicator role with generated password on node1
Base-backed-up node2 and node3 from node1 as async streaming standbys (with -R for auto recovery config)
Verified initial replication: created repl_test table, inserted baseline rows, confirmed presence on both standbys
Simulated primary loss: stopped postgresql on node1 after confirming standbys fully caught up (zero replay lag)
Promoted node2 via pg_ctl promote; verified all previously committed rows present, no data loss; inserted new row on node2 to confirm writability
Repointed node3's primary_conninfo to node2 and restarted; confirmed streaming and full data presence
Rebuilt node1 via fresh pg_basebackup from node2 (new primary) since original timeline diverged after promotion; started node1 as standby of node2
Verified node2 sees both node1 and node3 streaming, inserted new row to confirm full end-to-end replication health
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime on all 3 nodes and confirmed cluster health baseline
Rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified postgresql active and standby recovered with all data
Rebooted node3, confirmed new boot_id, verified standby recovery and data
Verified node2 (primary) saw both standbys reconnected before restarting it
Rebooted node2 (primary), confirmed new boot_id, verified it resumed as writable primary with all data and both standbys reconnected
Performed final write on node2 and confirmed replication to node1 and node3 (6/6 rows on all nodes)

evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
evidence.summary: node1 started as primary with wal_level=replica; node2 and node3 base-backed-up as standbys, both confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=t and streaming in node1's pg_stat_replication

evidence.requirement: Committed data replicates to standbys
evidence.summary: Baseline rows inserted on node1 primary confirmed present on both node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Failover without losing committed data when primary is lost
evidence.summary: Confirmed zero replay lag, inserted pre-failover-row-3, stopped node1 (simulated primary loss), promoted node2 via pg_ctl promote and verified all 3 rows including pre-failover-row-3 present with no loss

evidence.requirement: New primary is writable and remaining standby follows it
evidence.summary: Inserted post-failover-row-4 on newly promoted node2; repointed node3 to stream from node2 and confirmed row present; node2's pg_stat_replication shows node3 streaming

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary rejoins as standby of current primary
evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby, confirmed pg_is_in_recovery=t with all 4 committed rows; node2 shows both node1 and node3 streaming

evidence.requirement: Full post-recovery end-to-end replication check
evidence.summary: post-recovery-row-5 inserted on node2 (primary) and confirmed present on both node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, service/data recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id aad96cc9...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id changed to 8b674b31...; postgresql active, standby recovered with all 5 rows; node2 confirms node1 reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, service/data recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 739c9792...; reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id changed to a74d7a73...; postgresql active, standby recovered with all 5 rows; node2 confirms both standbys streaming before proceeding

evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, service/cluster recovery with quorum preserved
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 7223d5b7...; confirmed both standbys healthy before restart (independent recovery path preserved); reboot acknowledged; post-restart boot_id changed to c56a9e16...; postgresql active, resumed as writable primary with all data, both standbys reconnected streaming

evidence.requirement: Final cluster-wide health verification after all restarts
evidence.summary: Inserted post-all-restarts-row-6 on node2; confirmed count=6 rows present on both node1 and node3 standbys
